📝 Listening Script — Track 36صفحة 27 · تمرين B
Page 27. B. Listen to the story Fred the Clown. What is it about? Choose the correct picture. Fred the Clown. Fred is a clown. He has a green guitar. He has a red skateboard. He has a blue balloon. But where is Fred's car? I don't have my yellow car, says Fred. There's Joe. Joe is in a yellow car. It's Fred's car. Joe, says Fred. You have my car. Oh, says Joe. I'm sorry.
1What is the story about?
💡 Why A?
  • The story is about Fred's things and their colors, and at the end he says You have my yellow car! — so the yellow car and the other clown (Joe) are a key part of the story.

27Story — Fred the Clown صح أم خطأ

📖 من الكتاب

Now choose ✔ or ✘.

1Fred doesn't have the car.
✔ True (example in the book) — Joe has the car.
2Fred sees Joe.
✔ True — at the end of the story Fred sees his friend Joe in the yellow car.
3Joe has Fred's guitar.
✘ False — Joe has the car, not the guitar. Fred has the green guitar.
🤔 Think!
  • What colors are your toys? What colors are your friends' toys?

E — Look at D. Write. Use have, has, or don't have.

1He ________ a green guitar.
has (example in the book)
2He ________ a red skateboard.
has — the subject He is third person singular.
3I ________ an orange balloon. · I ________ a blue balloon.
don't have … have — the balloon in the picture is blue, not orange.
4I ________ my car. · You ________ my yellow car!
don't have … have — Joe has the yellow car, not Fred.
